description: Explains one validation rule id, such as BR-CO-15, BR-DE-15, PEPPOL-EN16931-R003 or BR-FR-05: the publisher's official wording from the compiled rule sets and, where available, a plain-language summary, the reason for the rule and how to fix it. Use it after validate_invoice reports a rule you need to explain or fix, or when a user asks what a rule means. It does not check an invoice; call validate_invoice for that. An unknown id is not an error: the result has `found` false and an empty `official` list; say so and do not guess. Reads the bundled rule sets; no network.
name: explain_validation_rule

found.description: False when no compiled rule set knows this id.

official.description: Official wording, one entry per rule set that defines the id.

text.description: The publisher's wording of the rule.

plainLanguage.description: Plain-language explanation, when one exists for this rule.

fix.description: How to change the invoice so the rule passes.

summary.description: What the rule requires, in plain language.

why.description: Why the rule exists or why it typically fires.

ruleId.description: The rule id as looked up.

title: Explain a validation rule
